subject.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)

question: Should maintainers make this PR the canonical fix for the Telegram over-limit `/model` callback issue after the ordering bug is repaired, or choose the open sibling implementation instead?
rationale: Both open candidates solve the same user-visible Telegram picker bug with different callback contracts, and provider/model callback routing should be intentional before merge.

options.title: Repair and use this PR
options.body: Fix the direct-command sort mismatch, then land this minimal fallback if maintainers prefer preserving name-based callbacks for all models that fit.

options.title: Choose the sibling candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 as the canonical branch if maintainers prefer its broader indexed callback contract, then pause or close this PR.

options.title: Hold both for owner selection
options.body: Keep both candidates open until a Telegram owner explicitly selects the callback format, accepting another review round trip.

recommendation.title: Repair and use this PR
recommendation.body: Fix the direct-command sort mismatch, then land this minimal fallback if maintainers prefer preserving name-based callbacks for all models that fit.

likelyOwner.reason: The byte-limit helper and compact callback history make this the best available owner for the Telegram callback-format decision.
